sources.note: No record of listed by Glottolog as a grammar, grammar sketch or phonology exists for Janji. Janji-specific data are all wordlists: Meek 1931 vol. II; Shimizu 1975 (Languages of Jos Division, 27 pp.); Shimizu 1979 (A&Ü 62(4): 253-271, 'Five wordlists with analyses', language code Janji [jni] + Iguta, Sanga, Lemoro, Izora); Williamson & Shimizu 1968 / Williamson 1973 BCCW; Armstrong n.d. ms. The remainder are ethnographic/sociolinguistic overviews (Gunn 1953, Sommer 1992, Wente-Lukas 1985) or catalogues (Blench Atlas, Ethnologue).
